title: Proper direct image through the schematic closure
statement:
In the situation of [det-nagata-density-normalization-sheaves], for every
$K\in D(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute{e}t}},\Lambda_X)$ there is a canonical
isomorphism in $D(S_{\mathrm{pro\acute{e}t}},\Lambda_S)$

$$
Rp_*j_!K\simeq R(p\circ i)_*j_{Z,!}K .
$$

proof.text: The statement of [det-nagata-density-normalization-setup] assumes that $\overline X$ is Noetherian (locally Noetherian and quasi-compact), and its clause (2) gives that $i:Z\hookrightarrow\overline X$ is the closed complement of the quasi-compact open $V$ in the qcqs scheme $\overline X$. The required quasi-compactness is quasi-compactness of the open immersion: for every affine open $W\subseteq\overline X$, the intersection $V\cap W$ is an open subscheme of the Noetherian scheme $\overline X$, so [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-open-subscheme-noetherian] says that its underlying space is quasi-compact. Apply the sheaf-exactness clause of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-open-closed-recollement] to this pair and to the given condensed coefficient ring with its pulled-back coefficient sheaves. It says that both $i^*$ and $i_*$ come from exact functors on module sheaves. Only this sheaf clause is used; its bounded-below derived adjunctions are not being applied to an unbounded object. Therefore [def-sfb-right-derived-exact], with $F=i_*$, gives the canonical comparison $Ri_*\simeq D(i_*)$ on the whole unbounded derived category. Here $D(i_*)$ is the functor applying $i_*$ degreewise, denoted simply by $i_*$ in the statement.

source.place: Tag 09BM, lemma-closed-immersion-complement-retrocompact-exact; condensed module-sheaf version in Hemo–Richarz–Scholbach Lemma 3.4; exact derived comparison: derived.tex Tag 015F, lemma-right-derived-exact-functor; blueprint Step 1

proof.text: The module-sheaf adjunction of [def-sfb-module-upper-lower-adjunction] for $i$ is $i^*\dashv i_*$. Its left adjoint is exact by step 1, so [lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective], with $v=i^*$ and $u=i_*$, shows that degreewise $i_*$ takes every K-injective complex of $\Lambda_Z$-modules to a K-injective complex of $\Lambda_{\overline X}$-modules. These are the actual module functors for the same pulled-back coefficient ring; no comparison with a different coefficient category or with derived abelian-sheaf direct images is used.

source.place: Tag 08BJ, lemma-adjoint-preserve-K-injectives; supplies the resolution argument for blueprint Step 2

proof.text:
We construct, rather than assume, the derived composition comparison. Put $h=p\circ i$ and write $Q_T$ for homotopy-category localization on $T$. By [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], all three derived direct images are total right derived functors of the indicated module functors, computed on K-injective resolutions. The underived natural isomorphism $c:p_*i_*\xrightarrow{\sim}h_*$ is exactly [def-sfb-module-lower-star-comp], with $f=i$ and $g=p$.

Let $\eta_i,\eta_p,\eta_h$ be the right-derived units of [def-sfb-right-derived-functor]. On a homotopy complex $A$ on $Z$, form
$$Q_S(p_*i_*A)\xrightarrow{\eta_{p,i_*A}}Rp_*Q_{\overline X}(i_*A)\xrightarrow{Rp_*(\eta_{i,A})}Rp_*Ri_*Q_Z(A).$$
Precomposing with $Q_S(c_A^{-1})$ gives a natural transformation $Q_Sh_*\to Rp_*Ri_*Q_Z$. The universal property in [def-sfb-right-derived-functor] yields a unique natural transformation $\theta:Rh_*\to Rp_*Ri_*$ whose composite with $\eta_h$ is this transformation.

For a K-injective $I$ on $Z$, the unit $\eta_{h,I}$ and $\eta_{i,I}$ are isomorphisms. The complex $i_*I$ is K-injective by step 2, so $\eta_{p,i_*I}$ is also an isomorphism. The defining equation for $\theta$ thus shows that $\theta_{Q_ZI}$ is an isomorphism. Every object of $D(Z_{\mathrm{pro\acute{e}t}},\Lambda_Z)$ has a K-injective representative by the resolution description in [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]; naturality then shows that every component of $\theta$ is invertible. Its inverse is the required canonical natural isomorphism $Rp_*Ri_*\simeq R(p\circ i)_*$. This uses no boundedness or finite cohomological dimension. Uniqueness in the displayed universal property makes the comparison independent of resolution choices.

source.place: Tags 070Y (lemma-K-injective-defined) and 070K (lemma-enough-K-injectives-implies); explicit derived-unit construction elaborating blueprint Step 2

proof.text:
For the given $K$, the unbounded-complex clause of [det-nagata-density-normalization-sheaves] gives the canonical natural isomorphism $j_!K\simeq i_*j_{Z,!}K$ in the derived category on $\overline X$. Apply the functor $Rp_*$, replace degreewise $i_*$ by $Ri_*$ using step 1, and apply step 3 to $j_{Z,!}K$. Their composite is
$$Rp_*j_!K\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_*i_*j_{Z,!}K\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_*Ri_*j_{Z,!}K\xrightarrow{\sim}R(p\circ i)_*j_{Z,!}K.$$
The three factors are natural isomorphisms for the same coefficient ring, so their composite is the canonical isomorphism asserted, with target in $D(S_{\mathrm{pro\acute{e}t}},\Lambda_S)$.
